## The 2018 FBI Wiretap — Banks on Tape

In 2016, the FBI obtained a warrant to wiretap **Gasper Fiore's** phone, targeting **18 people** for extortion, wire fraud, bribery, and conspiracy to distribute marijuana. Banks was a **"target subject."**

FBI Special Agent Robert Beeckman wrote in the sworn affidavit:

> **"Fiore is involved in bid-rigging with legislator Brian Banks."**

The wiretap recorded conversations between Banks and Fiore discussing:
- Banks's efforts to help Fiore secure an **MDOT contract**
- How Banks could advocate for Fiore with a **"high-ranking police official"**
- Whether Fiore's daughter **Jennifer** would stop pushing legislative amendments if Fiore got the contract

Jennifer Fiore — Gasper's daughter — was simultaneously **dating Detroit Councilman Gabe Leland**, who approved **$2M+ in city contracts** for her connected companies. When Leland asked **Police Chief James Craig** about the FBI towing investigation, Craig contacted the FBI.

The wiretap documents were **accidentally released in 2018**, then quickly resealed. They listed **Banks, Judge Vonda Evans, Sheriff Benny Napoleon, Councilman Leland, and Rep. Tinsley-Talabi** as target subjects.

### The FBI Files Are Now in Civil Court

In *Area Towing v. Sollars, 2:19-cv-10989 (E.D. Mich.)*, Area Towing subpoenaed the FBI wiretap files in **March 2025**. The court ordered the FBI to produce unredacted copies (Sep 3, 2025). Fiore tried to intervene and seal the files — **denied** by Judge Linda V. Parker (Dec 2025). Fiore was deposed **December 29, 2025** and pled the Fifth to nearly every question. The court ordered him to answer by **March 6, 2026**.

**The FBI wiretap files containing Banks's conversations are now in the civil case record.**

## The Institutional Localization Principle

Traditional corruption hides behind jurisdictional boundaries. This network cannot — because its members hold positions in institutions with **institutional superiors who are now on notice**.

When a board member is notified, their university is notified. When a judge is notified, their chief judge is notified. When an AAG is notified, the AG's office is notified. The bad actors cannot hide because they are **institutionally localized** — their positions are their prisons.

This page will continue expanding as the investigation develops. Each node added to the graph becomes visible to every other node already mapped.

**The protection is structural, not coincidental.** Every arrow is a documented public record connection. No single regulator sees the full web because each institution (schools, courts, campaign finance, LARA) operates in its own silo.

## The Capture Pattern — Three Domains

| Domain | Function | Capture Effect |
|--------|----------|----------------|
| **Schools** | Revenue source | Public education dollars become private revenue |
| **Courts** | Protection | Network-connected judges handle enterprise cases |
| **Political** | Authorization | Allies authorize charters and provide institutional cover |

See also: [RICO Pattern](/analysis/rico-pattern/) — full enterprise structure.

## 1. Schools (Revenue Source)

| Institution | Capture Method | Effect |
|-------------|---------------|--------|

## The Silo Problem {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

Each institution sees only its piece:

| Regulator | What They See | What They Miss |

| **LARA** | Individual entities | Common control at 1968 Severn Road |
| **IRS** | Individual returns | Self-dealing across foundation + LLC |
| **Bar** | No complaints about Banks | He was never admitted |

**This is by design.** The enterprise operates across silos precisely because no single regulator sees the full picture.

## Breaking the Silo

========================================================================
URL: https://detroit.primals.eco/analysis/land-deal/
File: site/content/analysis/land-deal.md
========================================================================
The PCA charter contract with DPSCD includes a provision where Purpose Group LLC can purchase the school building at 10101 E. Canfield, Detroit. This provision is documented in the management agreement obtained via FOIA. This analysis examines the mechanism and its implications.

*Source: Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA).*

> **Analytical inference, not a legal finding.** The implications described below reflect the complainant's analysis of the contract mechanism and public records. They have not been adjudicated by any court or regulatory body.

## The Mechanism

The building purchase option operates through a chain of charter authorization, management fees, and contractual property rights:

1. **DPSCD authorizes the charter.** DPSCD authorizes Brian Banks to run Purpose Charter Academy in a district building at 10101 E. Canfield. *Source: DPSCD charter authorization records; Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA).*

2. **Purpose Group collects fees and costs.** Banks' management company, The Purpose Group LLC, collects 10% of state aid plus reimbursement for all operating costs under the management agreement. *Source: Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA), Section 5.1 (10% of Gross State School Aid); Section 5.3 (operating cost reimbursement).*

3. **Purpose Group can exercise the purchase option.** After establishing the school, Purpose Group LLC can exercise a building purchase option embedded in the management agreement. *Source: Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA), building purchase provision.*

4. **Ownership transfers to the management company.** If exercised, the building would be owned by Purpose Group LLC — the same entity that employs all staff and takes 72.67% of revenue from the sister school, MacDowell Preparatory Academy. *Source: Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA); MDE financial records (72.67% revenue to Purpose Group LLC).*

## Who Benefits

| Party | What They Get | Source |
|-------|---------------|--------|
| Banks / Purpose Group | Building ownership (via purchase option) + 10% management fee + operating cost reimbursement | Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA); MDE financial records |
| Judge Miller (PCA Board Chair) | Board position at a publicly-funded school — governance power | PCA board records; DPSCD charter authorization |
| DPSCD | 3% authorization fee (~$147K/yr from MacDowell alone) | MDE financial reports; charter authorization fee structure |
| Wells-Stallworth | 12+ year Board presidency at a $4.9M/yr operation | MacDowell board records; MDE financial reports ($4.9M state aid) |

## Who Loses

| Party | What They Lose | Source |
|-------|----------------|--------|
| Students (362 MacDowell + PCA enrollment) | Education outcomes — 3% math proficiency, 12% reading proficiency, uncredentialed teachers | MDE assessment data; SchoolDigger; U.S. News; MOECS credential audit (Sep 26, 2026) |
| Michigan taxpayers | $4.9M+/yr to an operation where 72.67% goes to one LLC | MDE financial reports |
| Detroit public school system | Public building potentially converted to private ownership | Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA), building purchase provision; DPSCD property records |

## The Pattern

This is not unique to Banks. Charter management organizations across the country have used similar building purchase provisions to convert public school property into private assets.

What makes this case distinctive — **analytical inference** — is the combination of factors present simultaneously:

- A building purchase option exists in the PCA management agreement
- The management company is controlled by a superintendent with 9 criminal convictions
- The sister school (MacDowell) is ranked in the bottom 3% of Michigan (1,443 of 1,488)

*Sources: Purpose Group Management Agreement (FOIA); DPSCD authorization records; SchoolDigger statewide ranking; criminal conviction records on file.*

- **DPSCD Charter Authorization records** — public meeting minutes and authorization documents
- **[Michigan LARA MiBusiness Registry](https://mibusinessregistry.lara.state.mi.us/search/business)** — search "Purpose Group" for LLC registration

## The Question

How did self-ordained messengers of the Word — people who claim divine authority to shepherd their flocks — allow a man with nine criminal convictions into positions of power over the most vulnerable children in Detroit?

This is not an attack on faith. It is not an attack on the Black church. It is not an attack on Pentecostal tradition.

It is a question the **congregations themselves** deserve to have answered by the leaders who made these decisions in their name.

## What Happened

| Leader | Title | Church | What They Did for Banks |
|--------|-------|--------|------------------------|
| **Bishop J. Drew Sheard** | Presiding Bishop, Church of God in Christ (COGIC) — the **largest Black Pentecostal denomination in America** | Greater Emmanuel Institutional COGIC, Detroit | **Endorsed Banks for state office** (Ballotpedia). Banks hosted "Monday Night Praise with Purpose" at Sheard's church. |
| **Bishop Corletta Vaughn** | Self-consecrated bishop (Nigeria, 1995). Senior Pastor, Holy Ghost Cathedral. Presiding Bishop, Go Tell It Evangelistic Ministry Worldwide (~70 churches). Cast member, Oxygen's *Preachers of Detroit*. | Holy Ghost Cathedral Church, Detroit | **DPSCD Board President** — authorized Banks' charter schools while sitting on the board. At Banks' events (Facebook captures). **Disqualified from 2026 reelection** for $950 owed to Wayne County. |
| **Brian Banks** | Self-styled "Dr." with fake J.D. | **City Hill Church** (LARA #802365641). **Great Lakes Vision for Evangelism** (LARA #802210862). | Controls two religious nonprofit entities. Hosted "Purpose" branded church events. Uses church infrastructure for network legitimacy. |

## The Endorsement

From [Ballotpedia](https://ballotpedia.org/Brian_Banks), Banks' list of political endorsers included:

> *"Bishop J. Drew Sheard, Greater Emmanuel Institutional COGIC"*

Bishop Sheard is not a fringe figure. He is the **head of the entire Church of God in Christ** — a denomination with **6.5 million members** and **12,000+ congregations** across the United States. When he endorsed Brian Banks, he put the weight of the largest Black Pentecostal denomination behind a man with six felony convictions.

Sheard's congregation at Greater Emmanuel was never asked. The 6.5 million COGIC members were never consulted. A shepherd endorsed a wolf, and the flock was not told why.

## The Authorization

Bishop Corletta Vaughn sat on the DPSCD Board that authorized Purpose Charter Academy — a school run by a 9-time convicted felon with a fake J.D., where a sitting judge chairs the board and an Assistant Attorney General serves as Vice Chair.

Vaughn's "bishop" title was conferred in Nigeria in 1995 by Archbishop Benson Idahosa of the Church of God Mission. She was raised COGIC but left because COGIC does not ordain women as pastors or bishops. She founded her own network — Go Tell It Evangelistic Ministry Worldwide — and claims oversight of 70+ churches.

She used her position on the school board — the elected, secular, taxpayer-funded position — to authorize schools for a convicted felon. She was at his events. She posted support on social media. And when it came time for accountability, she was **disqualified from reelection** for $950 owed to Wayne County — the county run by Eric Sabree, whose children sit on the network's courts.

## The Church Entities

Banks doesn't just benefit from church endorsements. He **controls** church entities:

| Entity | LARA # | Filed | Registered Agent | Status |
|--------|--------|-------|-----------------|--------|
| **City Hill Church** | 802365641 | Sep 19, 2019 | Trenton Herald | Active |
| **Great Lakes Vision for Evangelism** | 802210862 | Jun 28, 2018 | Rev. Bruce Adams | Active |

Banks is an officer or director of both entities. Religious nonprofits receive tax exemptions and face minimal reporting requirements. They are the least transparent entities in his portfolio — and the least scrutinized.

## What the Congregations Don't Know

The members of Greater Emmanuel COGIC — Bishop Sheard's church — likely do not know that their bishop endorsed a man who:

- Has **9 criminal convictions** including 6 felonies (fraud, forgery, uttering & publishing)
- Claims a **J.D. from MSU College of Law** but has **never been admitted to any bar**
- Runs two charter schools where **3% of students** can do grade-level math
- Extracts **72.67% of school revenue** through a shell management company
- Is the **nephew of a BMF defendant** in the largest federal drug conspiracy case in Detroit history
- Was investigated by the **FBI** in a wiretap of a bribery scheme
- Had a legislative aide accuse him of **sexual harassment** (state paid $97K to settle)

The members of Holy Ghost Cathedral — Bishop Vaughn's church — likely do not know that their bishop authorized a charter school for this man while sitting on a taxpayer-funded school board, attended his events, and then took a position on the DPSCD board without disclosing these relationships.

The congregations were never told. The lambs were never warned.

## A Note on Faith

This analysis does not question whether God calls women to ministry. It does not question whether self-ordination or independent consecration is valid. It does not question the sincerity of anyone's faith.

It questions **judgment**. It questions **accountability**. It questions whether leaders who claim the authority to guide their flocks toward righteousness exercised even the most basic discernment before endorsing and empowering a man whose public criminal record was available to anyone who looked.

The children in Banks' schools are disproportionately from the same communities these churches serve. Many of their families sit in these pews on Sunday. They trust their shepherds to protect them — not to hand them to wolves.

> *"Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves. You will know them by their fruits."*
> — Matthew 7:15-16

The fruit is 3% math proficiency. The fruit is $4.9 million in public money flowing through shell entities. The fruit is fake credentials on school websites. The fruit is an investigation killed in 2 hours and 24 minutes.

**The congregations of Greater Emmanuel, Holy Ghost Cathedral, and every church whose leadership endorsed or enabled Brian Banks have the right to know what was done in their name — and to hold their shepherds accountable.**

## What the Congregations Can Do

1. **Ask your pastor directly**: Did you or our church endorse Brian Banks? Why? Did you know about his criminal record?
2. **Review your church's political endorsements**: Who else has been endorsed from your pulpit without your knowledge?
3. **Request transparency**: If your bishop sits on a public school board, ask them to disclose all relationships with charter school operators.
4. **Protect the children**: If your church partners with Purpose Charter Academy or MacDowell Preparatory Academy, ask what due diligence was performed.
5. **Demand accountability**: Shepherds who fail to protect the flock should answer to the flock — not hide behind titles.

## The Child in the Basement

> *"In my Father's house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?"* — John 14:2

In Ursula K. Le Guin's *The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas*, a perfect city's prosperity depends on one child locked in a basement, kept in perpetual filth and misery. Most citizens learn the truth and accept it. Some walk away. Le Guin never tells us where they go.

In the ecoPrimals project — the philosophical and technical framework from which this website was built — we asked the next question: **what if you went back?**

> *"Our ethos is not one of abandonment, but of liberation. We do not walk away. We return to Omelas with tools."*
> — [The Return to Omelas](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/return-to-omelas/)

The children in Detroit's charter schools are not a metaphor. They are the child in the basement — kept in a system that produces **3% math proficiency** while extracting **$4.9 million per year** through shell entities. The city's institutions — its schools, courts, churches, treasury, legislature, and banks — are the walls of the basement. This analysis maps those walls.

This is not the first time the ecoPrimals framework has named this pattern. In [The City of Omelas](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/atlasHugged/01/) — the first chapter of *atlasHugged* — the argument was made in general terms:

> *"The basement is bigger than one child. It is the sweatshop in Shenzhen. It is the pollution in the river. It is milk poured into gutters during the Great Depression while a hundred miles away, families went hungry. The suffering that sustains Omelas is human suffering — all of it, every structural position where someone bears a cost that someone else's prosperity hides."*

Detroit is the specific case. The child has a name. The basement has an address. The keepers have public records.

---

## I. The River Keeper Pattern

In [The Temptation of Kingdoms](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/atlasHugged/06/), the ecoPrimals framework identifies a pattern that recurs at every scale in every civilization:

> *"Someone finds a river. The river feeds a valley. The settlement grows. And then someone builds a tollbooth on the river. The river keeper does not create the water. He controls the access to it."*

The pattern is:
1. A resource exists independent of the mediator
2. The mediator positions himself between people and the resource
3. The mediation extracts value proportional to the dependency it creates
4. The dependency is maintained by making alternatives appear impossible

The resource changes. The pattern does not. The river keeper becomes the priestly class. The priestly class becomes the feudal lord. The feudal lord becomes the colonial company. The colonial company becomes the cloud provider.

**In Detroit, the resource is children.**

Per-pupil funding flows from the state to schools based on headcount. The children are the river. Brian Banks built the tollbooth. Purpose Group LLC is the mediation — extracting 72.67% of what flows through. The dependency is maintained because the parents are trapped (Section III below), and the alternatives have been captured (Section I.A below).

Banks did not create the children. He did not create the funding. He did not create the educational need. He positioned himself between the children and the money allocated for their education, and he charges for passage.

### I.A — The Architecture of Capture

The machine works because it controls **every level simultaneously**. No single layer of capture would survive scrutiny — but when every layer protects every other layer, the system becomes self-reinforcing.

> *"The resource changes. The pattern does not."* — atlasHugged, Chapter 6

| Level | Captured By | River Keeper Pattern | What It Controls |
|-------|------------|---------------------|-----------------|
| **Schools** | Banks (superintendent), Purpose Group LLC | Tollbooth between children and education funding | Per-pupil dollars → 72.67% extraction |
| **Courts** | 9 judges across 4 courts | Priestly class mediating access to justice | Cases involving the enterprise land before network judges |
| **Churches** | Bishop Sheard (COGIC), Bishop Vaughn (DPSCD) | Credential of divine authority lent to temporal actors | Congregations unknowingly legitimize convicted felons |
| **Treasury** | Eric Sabree (Wayne County Treasurer) | Feudal lord controlling access to land | Tax foreclosures feed the network's property acquisition |
| **Legislature** | Banks (HD-1), Gay-Dagnogo (HD-8), Stallworths (HD-7/8) | Colonial company writing the rules of trade | Laws that should protect children are written by exploiters |
| **Financial** | PSCU (shared credit union) | Banking infrastructure as private highway | $549K+ in enterprise mortgages through shared lender |
| **Regulatory** | Schmiedeknecht (MDE), Vaughn/Gay-Dagnogo (DPSCD) | Guard hired by the tollkeeper | Investigation killed in 2hr 24min; authorizer is the ombudsman |
| **Complaints** | Gay-Dagnogo (Ombudsman, 10yr term) | The complaint box routes to the accused | Accountability system is a closed loop |

**When every wall of the basement is load-bearing, removing one doesn't free the child — the ceiling collapses.**

The solution is not to remove one wall. The solution was articulated in atlasHugged: *"The answer is not to reform the river keeper. The answer is to give everyone a well."* This website is the well — an ungated, uncaptured, public-record-sourced instrument that connects every cell of the enterprise and makes the capture visible.

---

## II. The Plea Bargain Machine — Two-Tier Justice

### The Bread Thief and the Preconditions

In [The Loaves and the Fishes](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/atlasHugged/05/), the ecoPrimals framework examines the classical libertarian question — *is it wrong for a man to steal bread to feed his family?* — and finds it hyperlocal:

> *"The bread thief stands in front of you. His act is visible, immediate, and classifiable. He violated a boundary. The philosophy handles it cleanly: wrong. But the question that classical libertarianism does not ask — the question it is structurally unable to ask from inside its local frame — is: what are the preconditions? Why is this man stealing bread?"*

The plea bargain system is the precondition machine. It operates in two directions — and the direction depends on who you are.

**Direction 1: Downward pressure on the powerless**

For the unconnected — disproportionately poor, disproportionately Black, disproportionately from neighborhoods like the ones Banks' schools serve — the plea bargain is a weapon:

- Overcharging creates fear. A defendant facing 20 years is offered 2 if they plead guilty.
- Public defenders carry 200+ cases. There is no time to investigate. The advice is: take the deal.
- The conviction follows them forever — employment, housing, voting, custody.
- The **4th Amendment** (unreasonable search and seizure) and **14th Amendment** (due process, equal protection) become theoretical rights with no practical application when a defendant cannot afford to assert them.

This is the system that *creates* the bread thief. The conviction destroys the ability to earn. The destroyed ability to earn creates the next generation of desperation. The desperation creates the next customer for the system.

> *"Self-ownership means nothing if the self is being poisoned by someone else's profit margin."*
> — atlasHugged, Chapter 5

**Direction 2: Upward protection for the connected**

For the connected — for people with political relationships, family money, or network leverage — the plea bargain is a **shield**:

| Actor | Original Charges | Pled To | Actual Sentence |
|-------|-----------------|---------|-----------------|
| **Brian Banks** (2016) | AG felony charges: U&P ×2 + False Pretenses | 1 misdemeanor | **1 day + probation** |
| **Keith Stallworth** (2003) | Conspiracy with 13 co-defendants | 1 count structuring | **Probation** (conspiracy charges **dropped**) |
| **Kenneth Daniels** (2014) | Drug conspiracy | 1 count structuring | **1 year** (kingpin got **LIFE**) |
| **Trenton Herald** (2026) | Embezzlement $100K+ | Embezzlement $1K–$20K | **24 months probation, no jail** |
| **Kwame Kilpatrick** (2013) | 24 federal felonies, RICO | — (convicted at trial) | 28 years → **commuted by Trump** |

In every case, the community never heard about the original charges. The plea deal sanitized the record. The sentence was a slap. The actor resumed their career — Banks went back to running schools, Stallworth went back to BCF, Daniels went back to politics, Herald went back to pastoring.

**The same system that crushes a 19-year-old from Banks' school district for a possession charge gives the school's superintendent probation for forgery.**

### The Structural Violation

This is the bread thief problem in reverse. The system steals the preconditions — clean records, stable housing, educational opportunity — and then blames the individual for failing to thrive without them. Meanwhile, the connected actors who *created* the conditions of failure walk free.

The **14th Amendment** guarantees equal protection under law. When the same judicial system that offers connected defendants minimal consequences for serious crimes simultaneously uses overcharging and plea pressure to extract guilty pleas from unconnected defendants, it violates equal protection on its face.

The **4th Amendment** guarantees freedom from unreasonable search and seizure. When defendants cannot afford to challenge the constitutionality of their arrests because the plea system incentivizes waiving that right, the 4th Amendment becomes a dead letter for the poor while remaining fully operative for the wealthy.

> *"Rights must hold at the edge of the system — where the accused, the hated, the forgotten stand. Otherwise they are not rights; they are rented privileges."*
> — [The Primal Ethos](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/primal-ethos/)

---

## III. The Wayne County Backlog — A Captive Population

Wayne County has one of the largest case backlogs in Michigan. Cases take years. Defendants wait in limbo — unable to resolve charges, unable to move on with their lives, unable to challenge conditions because challenging the system means staying in the system longer.

This backlog is not incidental. It creates a **captive population** — people who are technically free but functionally trapped:

- Outstanding warrants prevent employment
- Unresolved cases prevent housing applications
- Pending charges create leverage for anyone who can offer a "fix"
- Children in these families attend schools run by the people who benefit from the dysfunction

### The Non-Lawyer at the Intersection

Banks, the non-lawyer who claims a J.D., sits at the intersection of every system these families depend on. He controls schools (where the children go), has connections to courts (where the parents' cases are pending), holds political relationships (where favors are traded), and operates through churches (where trust is manufactured).

A parent who challenges their child's 3% math proficiency education risks drawing attention from a network that controls the courts their unresolved case sits in.

This is the harvest. The backlog is the pen. The children are the crop. The per-pupil funding is the yield.

In atlasHugged's language: *"The factory's profit margin is subsidized by the health of its neighbors."* Here, the enterprise's revenue is subsidized by the captivity of its families.

---

## IV. The Priest and the Levite

In [The Many Rooms](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/atlasHugged/09/), the ecoPrimals framework reexamines the parable of the Good Samaritan — not as a children's sermon about kindness, but as a structural critique of institutions that betray their mandate:

> *"A priest who touched a corpse became ritually unclean under Levitical law. Unclean meant unable to perform Temple duties. The institution's purity requirements created a structural incentive to look away. The law that was supposed to bring people closer to God produced a reason to walk past a dying man."*

Map this to Detroit.

**The Michigan Department of Education** is the priest. Its mandate is to protect students. When confronted with evidence that a convicted felon with a cash-handling prohibition was serving as superintendent of a school that spent 32% on instruction, MDE killed the investigation in **2 hours and 24 minutes**. The institution's own logic — its bureaucratic process, its inter-agency jurisdictional boundaries, its risk of political blowback — created a structural incentive to look away. Nicole Wells-Stallworth's call came at 10:02 AM. By 12:26 PM, the file was closed.

**The DPSCD Board** is the Levite. Its mandate is charter oversight. When the charter authorization for MacDowell came before the board, the board member who authorized it (Corletta Vaughn) was herself later disqualified from office for $950 in Wayne County fees. The woman who gave Banks permission to run a school couldn't maintain her own seat on the board that granted it.

**The COGIC Presiding Bishop** is the senior cleric. When Bishop J. Drew Sheard endorsed Brian Banks for State Representative, he lent the full weight of the Church of God in Christ — the largest Pentecostal denomination in the United States — to a man with 9 criminal convictions. Banks is a congregant of Sheard's Greater Emmanuel Institutional COGIC. The endorsement was not ignorance. It was institutional choice. The institution's own logic — the political relationships, the community standing, the mutual benefit — made the endorsement rational.

> *"The religious establishment — the credentialed, the institutional, the ones with the mandate and the resources and the rules — walked past. The outsider, the one with no obligation, no credential, no institutional backing, no recognized authority, stopped."*
> — atlasHugged, Chapter 9

One parent, with no law degree, no political connections, and no institutional backing, attended a Back to School Bash with his son and noticed that the superintendent wasn't a real lawyer. The institution that was supposed to notice had walked past for 14 years.

---

## V. Entities and County Lines — The Shell Game

> *"Every person who acquires capability faces the same offer: use your capability to become a more efficient king, or use it to eliminate the need for kings."*
> — atlasHugged, Chapter 6

Banks operates across **multiple jurisdictions** using entity structures designed to prevent any single regulator from seeing the whole picture:

| Entity | Jurisdiction | Regulator | What the Regulator Sees |
|--------|-------------|-----------|------------------------|
| Purpose Charter Academy | Detroit (DPSCD) | DPSCD Board | Charter school with paperwork |
| MacDowell Prep | Detroit (CMU authorized) | Central Michigan University | Charter school with paperwork |
| Purpose Group LLC | Grosse Pointe Woods (LARA) | State of Michigan | Management company |
| Purpose Foundation | Grosse Pointe Woods (IRS) | IRS | Small 501(c)(3) |
| Banks Strategy LLC | Grosse Pointe Woods (LARA) | State of Michigan | Consulting company |
| City Hill Church | Holland, MI (LARA) | None (religious exemption) | Church |
| Great Lakes Vision for Evangelism | LARA | None (religious exemption) | Religious organization |
| Banks residence | Grosse Pointe Woods | Wayne County suburbs | Affluent suburban homeowner |
| Schools served | Detroit | Wayne County | Poorest children in the state |

**The extraction happens in Detroit. The money lands in Grosse Pointe Woods. The entities are registered across jurisdictions. The church entities have no reporting requirements.**

County lines are not just geographic boundaries — they are **regulatory firewalls**. Each entity exists in a jurisdiction whose regulator has no visibility into the other jurisdictions. LARA sees corporate filings. DPSCD sees charter compliance. The IRS sees tax returns. No one sees the whole machine.

This is the same principle identified in atlasHugged's analysis of kingdoms: **compartmentalization as a structural property of extraction.** The feudal lord controlled land. The colonial company controlled trade routes. Banks controls entity registrations. The mechanism is the same: stand between the resource and the people, and make sure no one can see from one side to the other.

The FBI's RICO statute (18 USC 1961) was written specifically to pierce this structure — to connect the cells and show the enterprise. That is what this project does with public records.

## VI. The Community That Was Ravaged

While every level of the system was being captured, the community it was supposed to serve was being destroyed:

| Decade | What Happened to the Community | What the Machine Did |
|--------|-------------------------------|---------------------|
| **1980s** | Crack epidemic ravages Detroit neighborhoods | Chambers Brothers control 50% of crack houses. BMF builds empire. Keith Stallworth launders drug money. |
| **1990s** | Population collapse, factory closures | Political dynasties consolidate. Alma Stallworth founds BCF. |
| **2000s** | Kilpatrick corruption, housing crisis, bankruptcy | Tax foreclosures feed Sabree's pipeline. Land Bank properties acquired. |
| **2010s** | Schools close, emergency management | Banks enters Legislature. Charter schools open. Per-pupil funding becomes the new extraction mechanism. |
| **2020s** | COVID, learning loss, continued poverty | 3% math proficiency. 72.67% extraction. Children can't read. The machine counts their heads. |

**The same families destroyed by crack, foreclosed by the treasurer, bankrupted by the housing crisis, and failed by the public schools — those families' children now sit in Banks' classrooms. The machine has been harvesting from the same community for 40 years. Only the product changed: drugs → housing → education dollars.**

In atlasHugged's framework: *"The suffering that sustains Omelas is not one child. It is every structural position where someone bears a cost that someone else's prosperity hides."*

Here the structural position is Detroit itself — one of the poorest cities in America, where the poverty was not accidental but manufactured, decade by decade, by the same families who now run the schools.

---

## VII. Why We Build

This website is not a complaint. It is not a protest. It is not a petition to the institutions that walked past.

It is a tool.

> *"The most dangerous cage is not the one with iron bars, but the one with golden ones. It is the cage that is comfortable, convenient, and built by a benevolent keeper who promises to take care of you."*
> — [Autonomy and the Elegant Cage](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/autonomy/)

The institutions that were supposed to protect these children built elegant cages — charter authorization processes, oversight committees, regulatory frameworks — that give the appearance of accountability while producing none. The cage is comfortable for the institutions. The child is still in the basement.

This project does not ask permission from the machine. It does not route through captured complaint systems. It does not depend on regulators who see only their silo. It does not require anyone to be virtuous.

It connects every cell. It names every actor. It follows every dollar. It preserves every record with BLAKE3 cryptographic hashing that cannot be altered, deleted, or denied.

> *"Can you walk away and the room still serves? Can you disappear and the tools still work? Can you die and the covenant still holds? If yes, you prepared a room. If no, you built a throne."*
> — atlasHugged, Chapter 9

This site is a room, not a throne. It is built from public records that anyone can verify. It is hosted on sovereign infrastructure. Its provenance is braided and its assertions are falsifiable. If the person who built it disappeared tomorrow, the records would remain, the analysis would stand, and the evidence would speak for itself.

It was built by one person in one month because one child was placed in a school run by a convicted felon, and every institution that should have prevented it had been captured by the people who profit from it.

> *"I return to Omelas, to build a new city outside its gates. A city of shared burden, that no man may suffer for the good of others."*

The tools exist. The child is still in the basement.

**We return.**

## The Family Line

Banks is the nephew of Tonesa Welch through his biological father {{ fact(registry="bmf", field="father") }} — BMF Defendant #22 in *USA v. Flenory et al* ({{ fact(registry="bmf", field="father_case") }}).

Both authors produced books that follow the same structural pattern:

1. **Reframe criminal history** as personal growth / brand narrative
2. **Name zero victims** — the people harmed are invisible
3. **Express zero remorse** — "sorry" appears only as self-pity, never as apology
4. **Build the next enterprise** — the book is a credential, not a confession

## The "Sorry" Test

A genuine accountability narrative requires naming the harm, accepting responsibility, and making amends. Neither book passes any of these tests. Both treat their respective criminal enterprises as origin stories for personal brands.

The pattern matters because it continues in the charter schools: 3% math proficiency, 14% properly credentialed staff, 72.67% of revenue extracted — and the response from leadership is not reform but self-promotion.

## The Books

Tonesa Welch has published accounts of her involvement with the Black Mafia Family (BMF), including *The Black Mafia Family* and the memoir *Black Mafia Queen*. She has also appeared as a cast member on reality television programs related to the BMF brand. {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

Welch was a named defendant in *USA v. Flenory et al* (2:05-cr-80955, Eastern District of Michigan), the federal case that prosecuted the BMF drug enterprise.

## The Family Connection

Tonesa Welch is Brian Banks' aunt. Banks' biological father, **{{ fact(registry="bmf", field="father") }}**, was **BMF Defendant #22** in the same federal case. {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

This is not a distant association. It is a direct family line from a federal drug conspiracy case to the superintendent's office of two publicly funded Detroit charter schools.

## What the Book Does Not Say

Across hundreds of pages, Welch's BMF narrative does not: {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

- **Name a single victim** of the drug enterprise
- **Acknowledge the communities** destroyed by BMF's drug distribution network
- **Express remorse** for the human cost of the enterprise
- **Address the children** growing up in neighborhoods BMF operated in — some of whom now attend Banks' schools

The BMF story is presented as a **brand narrative** — glamorous, entrepreneurial, aspirational. The victims are invisible. The consequences fall on other people's families.

## The Parallel

| Feature | Welch's BMF Book | Banks' *It Had 2 Happen* |
|---------|-----------------|--------------------------|
| Criminal enterprise | Federal drug conspiracy | Financial fraud (9 convictions) |
| Framing | Glamour / brand building | Redemption / leadership |
| Victims named | Zero | Zero |
| Accountability | None | None |
| Apology | None | None |
| Current enterprise | Reality TV / media brand | Charter schools / public funds |
| Revenue model | Brand monetization | 72.67% of state aid via Purpose Group LLC |

Both books follow the same structural pattern: repackage criminal history as a narrative asset, never name the people harmed, never express genuine accountability, and use the narrative to build the next enterprise.

## The Professionalization of the Enterprise

The BMF enterprise moved drugs through Detroit and Atlanta. It was dismantled by federal prosecution. But the family network didn't dissolve — it adapted. {{ confidence(level="inference") }}

| Generation | Enterprise | Revenue Source | Public Accountability |
|------------|-----------|----------------|----------------------|
| BMF era | Drug distribution | Illegal narcotics | Federal prosecution (43 defendants) |
| Current era | Charter school management | Public education dollars ($4.9M/yr) | Bottom 3% performance, 14% credentialed staff |

The mechanism changed. The extraction pattern didn't. The books are artifacts of that transition — they establish the family brand narrative that bridges the two eras.

## The "Sorry" Test

A genuine accountability narrative requires three elements:

1. **Naming the harm** — who was hurt, specifically
2. **Accepting responsibility** — not "it had to happen" but "I chose this and people suffered"
3. **Making amends** — concrete actions to repair the damage

Neither book passes any of these tests. Both books treat their respective criminal enterprises as origin stories for personal brands. The word "sorry" — when it appears at all — is directed at the authors' own circumstances, never at the people they harmed.

This matters because the same pattern of zero accountability operates in the charter schools today. MacDowell students receive a 3% math proficiency education from 14% properly credentialed staff, and the response from leadership is not reform — it is self-promotion.

## Verify

- PACER: Case 2:05-cr-80955 (E.D. Michigan) — BMF defendant list (43 defendants)
- Amazon: search "Tonesa Welch" — book listings
- {{ source(key="ichat", query="SID 2029469K") }} — Brian Banks' criminal record
- [Brian Banks actor page](/network/actors/brian-banks/) — full BMF lineage documentation

*This analysis is based on the published texts, the PACER federal case record, and publicly documented family relationships. The books are commercially available. The federal case record is public.*

## The Book

*It Had 2 Happen* (ISBN 173575403X) is Brian Banks' self-published autobiography. The Amazon listing credits the author as **"Brian Banks J.D."** — a credential the State Bar of Michigan cannot confirm. {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

The book's central thesis is that Banks' criminal history was a necessary precursor to his current role as an education leader. The title itself — *It Had 2 Happen* — frames 9 criminal convictions not as choices with consequences, but as predetermined steps in a redemption narrative.

## What the Book Says vs. What the Record Shows

| Book's Framing | Public Record |
|---------------|---------------|
| Criminal history as "journey" | 9 convictions (6 felony, 3 misdemeanor) across 5 courts, 1998–2016 |
| Redemption through education | MacDowell Prep: 3% math proficiency, bottom 3% statewide |
| "Dr. Brian Banks, J.D., Ph.D." | State Bar of Michigan: zero results for "Brian Banks" |
| Overcoming adversity | ≤8 months confirmed incarceration for ≥12 felony charges (≥50 years statutory exposure) |
| Leadership and accountability | 72.67% of school revenue extracted to Purpose Group LLC |
| Transforming education | 2 of 14 instructional staff properly credentialed (MOECS audit Sep 2026) |

## The Apology That Never Comes

Across the entire book, Banks does not: {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

- **Name a single victim** of his financial crimes
- **Acknowledge harm** caused by his forgery, uttering & publishing, or fraudulent check schemes
- **Address the credential claims** — the "J.D." appears on the cover without disclosure that he was never admitted to any bar
- **Confront the performance record** — the children at his schools do not appear as people whose education matters
- **Express genuine remorse** — the framing is consistently self-congratulatory, repackaging criminal history as character development

The word "sorry" appears in the context of self-pity ("sorry state of affairs") — never as an apology to anyone harmed by his conduct.

## The Redemption Industry

Banks' autobiography is not an isolated document — it is a component of a broader credential amplification strategy: {{ confidence(level="inference") }}

1. **The book** establishes the "redemption" narrative
2. **The Pahara Fellowship** launders the narrative through a prestigious education network
3. **The school websites** repeat the J.D. and Ph.D. claims as established fact
4. **LinkedIn** broadcasts the credentials to a professional audience
5. **Judge Miller's endorsement** provides judicial validation of the narrative

Each layer reinforces the others. The book is the origin story; the institutions are the validators. None of them checked the State Bar.

## The Pattern: Narrative Without Accountability

Banks' book follows a pattern common in white-collar recidivism: the autobiography that reframes criminal history as entrepreneurial resilience. The distinguishing feature here is that the "redemption" involves control of public schools and public funds — institutions where the consequences of fraud fall on children.

362 students at MacDowell Preparatory Academy are receiving instruction from a staff where only 14% are properly credentialed, at a school ranked in the bottom 3% of Michigan, run by a superintendent with 9 criminal convictions who claims a law degree he does not hold.

The book calls this a success story.

## The Family Connection

Banks is the nephew of **Tonesa Welch** through his biological father **{{ fact(registry="bmf", field="father") }}** — BMF Defendant #22 in *USA v. Flenory et al* ({{ fact(registry="bmf", field="father_case") }}). {{ confidence(level="documented") }}

Welch has her own book — [*The Black Mafia Family*](/books/black-mafia-family/) — which follows the same pattern: hundreds of pages, zero victims named, zero accountability.

The family enterprise didn't dissolve. It professionalized. Both books are artifacts of that professionalization.

## Verify

- Amazon: search "It Had 2 Happen Brian Banks" — note the "J.D." in the author credit
- State Bar of Michigan: [michbar.org](https://www.michbar.org) — search "Brian Banks" (zero results)
- {{ source(key="ichat", query="SID 2029469K") }} — verify the 9 convictions
- Pahara Fellowship: [pahara.org/fellow/brian-banks](https://www.pahara.org/fellow/brian-banks) — the "J.D." claim repeated

*This analysis is based on the published text of "It Had 2 Happen," public criminal records, and the State Bar of Michigan's attorney search. The book is publicly available. The records are independently verifiable.*

## Corrections & Disputes

**If you believe you have been wrongly identified, or that the public record
has been misrepresented on this site, please contact me to discuss it. I will
amend the record as soon as possible.**

Truth is more important than being "right." The purpose of this site is to
document what the public record shows — not to harm anyone unfairly. If I've
gotten something wrong, I want to know.

This project is built on [ecoPrimals](https://sporeprint.primals.eco) —
a sovereign scientific computing ecosystem where
[reality owns itself](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/sovereign-science/).
In science, reproducibility is the standard. In law, truth is an
[absolute defense](/legal/). This site applies both principles to the
public record: every claim is traceable to a source document, every
correction is preserved, and the record speaks for itself.

The [atlasHugged essays](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/) explain
why I build this way — start with
[The City of Omelas](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/the-city-of-omelas/)
for the motivation, or
[Discovery Is Local](https://sporeprint.primals.eco/philosophy/discovery-is-local/)
for why I insist on primary sources over secondhand claims.

**Email:** [eco.primal@pm.me](mailto:eco.primal@pm.me)

Please include:
- The specific page and claim you believe is inaccurate
- The correct information with supporting documentation
- How you'd like to be identified (or if you prefer anonymity)

All corrections will be published transparently with the original wording,
the revised wording, the date of correction, and the reason — because the
correction history is part of the public record too.

We are the index — the place where the threads converge.

## How This Works

Each entry links to an independent article and maps it to pages in this
evidence library that cover the same ground. If you came here from one of
these articles, the cross-references show you what else the public record
reveals. If you came here first, these articles provide independent
verification and context.

## Independent Projects

Some coverage comes from independent investigative projects — self-sovereign
work by reporters who fund their own infrastructure, control their own publishing,
and answer to no editor. We treat these projects as peers, not just sources.

- **[Clutch Justice — Rita Williams](/coverage/clutch-justice/)** — Michigan courts, crime, and judicial accountability. Our primary analytical reference. Four direct-overlap articles, plus statewide judicial accountability reporting that contextualizes everything in this database.

## News Coverage

Established outlets have also covered the same subjects:

- **[Detroit Free Press](/coverage/elrick-back-to-fool/)** — M.L. Elrick's "Back to Fool" investigation (Aug 2023)
- **[Chalkbeat Detroit](/coverage/chalkbeat-purpose-authorization/)** — Purpose Charter Academy authorization (Sep 2025)

## Signal Categories

We cross-index external coverage in three categories:

1. **Direct overlap** — articles about the same people and entities we document
2. **Structural context** — articles about the Michigan systems (courts, authorizers, oversight) that enable the patterns we document
3. **Methodological** — articles about how public records work, how to obtain them, and what institutional record-keeping reveals

## The Article

**[Detroit school district approves new charter school for struggling youth](https://www.chalkbeat.org/detroit/2025/09/08/detroit-school-district-plans-to-authorize-a-new-charter-school/)** — Chalkbeat Detroit, September 8, 2025

Chalkbeat reported that DPSCD authorized Purpose Charter Academy to serve students
experiencing homelessness, chronic absenteeism, and juvenile justice involvement.
The school would lease a vacant DPSCD building with an option to purchase.
DPSCD receives a 3% authorization fee (~$81,000/year).

## What the Public Record Adds

Chalkbeat reported the authorization as news. This evidence library asks:
**how was a second school authorized for the same operator when the first school
ranks in the bottom 3% statewide?**

| What Chalkbeat Reported | What We Document |
|------------------------|-----------------|
| Purpose Charter Academy authorized | [Institutional Capture](/analysis/institutional-capture/) — the authorization process and who approved it |
| Board includes Judge Cylenthia Miller | [Judge Miller](/network/judges/cylenthia-miller/) — sitting judge on a charter school board |
| Board includes attorney Lamar Moreland | [Network connections](/network/) — mapped to other entities |
| DPSCD gets 3% fee (~$81K/year) | [Funding Flow](/analysis/funding-flow/) — the financial incentive to authorize |
| MacDowell operator claimed "improvement" | [Historical Pattern](/analysis/historical-pattern/) — the actual academic data |
| Lease of vacant Detroit Lions Academy building | [Land Deal](/analysis/land-deal/) — property transactions in the network |

## The Oversight Gap

Chalkbeat quoted board member Sherry Gay-Dagnogo supporting the authorization.
This evidence library documents [Gay-Dagnogo's campaign finance connections](/network/political/sherry-gay-dagnogo/) to the same network.

Michigan law (MCL 380.507) requires closure of schools in the bottom 5% for three
consecutive years. Michigan law (MCL 380.502) allows suspension of an authorizer's
power for inadequate oversight. Neither has been triggered.

2. **[Network Map](/network/)** — see who approved what, and who they're connected to
3. **[Sources](/sources/)** — every database we used, so you can check everything

## The Article

Rita's broader investigation into how Detroit institutions fail at the most
basic function: making and keeping records that allow accountability.

## Why This Matters

This evidence library exists because the records *do* exist — in OTIS, LARA,
campaign finance databases, court dockets, property records. The problem isn't
that the evidence is hidden. The problem is that no institution connected the
dots. That's the gap this site fills.

Clutch's "Detroit Files" series examines the institutional culture that makes
this gap possible. This evidence library is the practical demonstration: what
happens when someone actually pulls all the records together.

## The Project

**[Clutch Justice](https://clutchjustice.com)** — *Courts. Crime. Crochet.* — is Rita Williams'
independent investigative project covering Michigan courts, judicial accountability, and
criminal justice. She works from public records and court filings, publishes her methodology,
and provides academic citation formats (Bluebook, APA, MLA, Chicago) for every article.

She is not affiliated with this evidence library. We discovered her work because she was
investigating the same public records we were. The overlap is structural, not coordinated.

## Why We Cite Clutch Justice as Primary Analytical Reference

Most news coverage of charter school fraud is event-driven: "this happened today."
Rita's work is pattern-driven: she traces *how* institutional failures compound across
time, jurisdictions, and actors. That's the same methodology this evidence library uses.

Her work matters to this case in three categories:

### 1. Direct Coverage — Same Subjects

These articles investigate the same people and institutions documented in our database:

| Article | Date | Overlap |
|---------|------|---------|
| [MacDowell: $15,217/student, 3% math](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/13/macdowell-preparatory-academy-academic-financial-record/) | Sep 13, 2026 | Financial extraction, board composition, DPSCD authorization → [our coverage page](/coverage/clutch-macdowell-spending/) |
| [Judge Miller OWI: "The Proper Move"](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/07/14/judge-cylenthia-miller-owi-judicial-favoritism/) | Jul 14, 2026 | Boundary violation pattern, gun case connection → [our coverage page](/coverage/clutch-miller-owi/) |
| [FOIA and Your Michigan School Board](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/23/foia-michigan-school-board-records-guide/) | Sep 23, 2026 | Legal roadmap for parents to obtain charter school records → [our coverage page](/coverage/clutch-foia-guide/) |

### 2. Structural Context — Michigan Judicial System

These articles don't mention our subjects but document the *system* that enables them:

| Article | Date | Why It Matters |
|---------|------|----------------|
| [Trial by Mechanism, Part I: The Invisible Deciders](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/04/trial-by-mechanism-part-1-invisible-deciders/) | Sep 4, 2026 | Michigan's one-person grand jury collapse (*People v Peeler*) — the prosecutorial mechanism gap that lets connected actors avoid indictment |
| [Trial by Mechanism, Part V: Sealed by Statute](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/10/02/trial-by-mechanism-part-v-sealed-by-statute/) | Oct 2, 2026 | How statutory sealing prevents public scrutiny of judicial proceedings |
| [Pay to Play: The Actual Cost of Using a Michigan Court](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/10/01/pay-to-play-the-actual-cost-of-using-a-michigan-court/) | Oct 1, 2026 | Court fee barriers — relevant to pro se plaintiffs challenging captured institutions |
| [$675 for Assault From the Bench: Bradley Knoll](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/10/01/675-for-assault-from-the-bench-bradley-knolls-second-case/) | Oct 1, 2026 | Judicial accountability failures — the pattern is statewide, not isolated to Wayne County |
| [Barry County's Judge Is Missing](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/10/01/barry-countys-judge-is-missing-from-the-bench/) | Oct 1, 2026 | Court transparency failures — judges absent without public explanation |

| [Abusive Litigation Is Still Abuse](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/08/21/abusive-litigation-is-still-abuse-court-watchers-macomb-county/) | Aug 21, 2026 | Litigation used as harassment — Rita herself has been targeted, documenting the same structural abuse |

### 3. Evidentiary Method — Detroit Institutional Failure

| Article | Date | Why It Matters |
|---------|------|----------------|
| [The Detroit Files, Part I: The Room](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/21/detroit-files-part-1-the-room/) | Sep 21, 2026 | Four Detroit evidentiary failures reconstructed from public sources — the methodological foundation for why this evidence library exists → [our coverage page](/coverage/clutch-detroit-files/) |

## The Pattern

Rita's statewide coverage reveals that what we document in the Banks enterprise
is not anomalous. It is the *expected outcome* of Michigan's judicial and charter
school oversight structure:

- **Authorizers with financial incentives** to keep failing schools open
- **Judges with network connections** who appear in each other's proceedings
- **Accountability mechanisms** that exist in statute but aren't triggered
- **Record-keeping systems** that produce evidence no institution examines

Our evidence library documents one case in depth. Clutch Justice documents the
system that makes cases like ours possible. Together, the two projects create
a more complete picture than either could alone.

## Her Independence

Clutch Justice is a self-sovereign project. Rita funds it independently, publishes
on her own schedule, controls her own infrastructure, and answers to no editor.
She has been [targeted with litigation](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/08/21/abusive-litigation-is-still-abuse-court-watchers-macomb-county/)
for her investigative work — the same structural abuse this evidence library
documents.

We do not coordinate with Clutch Justice. We cite her because her work is good,
her methodology is rigorous, and her subjects overlap with ours. If you find
value in this evidence library, you should be reading her work too.

**→ [clutchjustice.com](https://clutchjustice.com)**

## The Article

**[MacDowell Preparatory Academy Spends $15,217 a Student. Three Percent Can Do Grade-Level Math.](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/13/macdowell-preparatory-academy-academic-financial-record/)** — Clutch Justice (Rita Williams), September 13, 2026

The most detailed independent financial and academic analysis of MacDowell to date.
Key findings: $15,217 per-pupil spending, 3% math proficiency, bottom 3% statewide
(1,443rd of 1,488 elementary schools), nearly $1M operating deficit, unexplained
gift-card-labeled payments, and DPSCD's authorization of a second school under the
same operator.

## What the Public Record Adds

Clutch Justice documented the financial and academic failures. This evidence library
maps the network that enables them:

| What Clutch Reported | What We Document |
|---------------------|-----------------|
| 3% math proficiency, bottom 3% statewide | [Historical Pattern](/analysis/historical-pattern/) — multi-year academic decline trajectory |
| $15,217/student spending with poor outcomes | [Funding Flow](/analysis/funding-flow/) — where the $4.9M annual allocation goes |
| Gift-card-labeled payments, no board review | [RICO Pattern](/analysis/rico-pattern/) — predicate act: financial extraction through controlled entities |
| DPSCD authorized Purpose Charter Academy | [Institutional Capture](/analysis/institutional-capture/) — how the authorizer was captured |
| Wells Stallworth as board chair | [Nicole Wells Stallworth](/network/institutional/wells-stallworth-nicole/) — full relationship mapping |
| Yancey as board member | [Judge Lisa Yancey](/network/judges/lisa-yancey/) — campaign finance connections, bench assignments |

## The Question Clutch Raised

> Michigan law requires a charter school ranked in the bottom 5 percent for three
> consecutive years to close (MCL 380.507). Has this provision been triggered?

This evidence library's [analysis section](/analysis/) traces why it hasn't:
the authorizer (DPSCD) has financial incentive to keep the charter open (3%
authorization fee ≈ $81,000/year), and the board members have network connections
to the operator. The oversight loop is captured.

## The Article

**[The Proper Move Was Not to Get Involved](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/07/14/judge-cylenthia-miller-owi-judicial-favoritism/)** — Clutch Justice (Rita Williams), July 14, 2026

Clutch documented Judge Cylenthia LaToye Miller's OWI courtroom appearance and the
boundary violation pattern — a sitting judge appearing in another judge's courtroom
in a way that creates implicit pressure on the proceedings.

## What the Public Record Adds

Miller isn't an isolated story. She sits at a critical node in the network
this evidence library documents:

| What Clutch Reported | What We Document |
|---------------------|-----------------|
| Miller OWI courtroom appearance | [Judge Cylenthia Miller](/network/judges/cylenthia-miller/) — full profile with all network connections |
| Boundary violation pattern | [Judicial Network](/network/judges/) — how judges in this network appear in each other's proceedings |
| Connects to gun case | [Institutional Capture](/analysis/institutional-capture/) — how judicial connections enable the enterprise |

## The Network Behind the Name

Miller is listed on Purpose Charter Academy's development team board
([Chalkbeat, Sep 2025](https://www.chalkbeat.org/detroit/2025/09/08/detroit-school-district-plans-to-authorize-a-new-charter-school/)).
A sitting Third Circuit Court judge on a charter school board run by a man
with 9 criminal convictions. This evidence library maps that connection and
every other one.

## The Series

**[Trial by Mechanism](https://clutchjustice.com/2026/09/04/trial-by-mechanism-part-1-invisible-deciders/)** — Clutch Justice (Rita Williams), September–October 2026

A multi-part investigation into Michigan's prosecutorial mechanisms, anchored by
*People v Peeler* (2022) — the Michigan Supreme Court decision that collapsed the
one-person grand jury process used in the Flint water crisis prosecutions.

## Why This Matters for This Case

This evidence library documents a [RICO pattern](/analysis/rico-pattern/) with 6
predicate acts spanning 14+ years. The natural question is: why hasn't anyone been
prosecuted?

Rita's "Trial by Mechanism" series answers that question at the structural level.
Michigan's prosecutorial mechanisms have specific gaps — gaps that are features of
the system, not bugs:

- The one-person grand jury was eliminated after *Peeler*
- County prosecutors have discretion not to charge
- Federal referrals can sit without action
- Civil remedies require the plaintiff to fund the entire process

This evidence library filed two civil actions and eight federal referrals precisely
because the criminal prosecution pathway is structurally blocked.

- **[For Attorneys](/contact/#for-attorneys)** — why pro se civil action was necessary
- **[Legal Protections](/legal/)** — the defensive legal framework for publishing this evidence

Elrick documented that MacDowell Preparatory Academy's board hired Brian Banks as principal

## RICO Pattern

The complainant alleges that the Banks network operates a pattern that warrants agency review under racketeering statutes:

```
BRIAN RODERICK BANKS (9 convictions, claimed J.D. not confirmed by bar records)
│
├── REVENUE ─── Charter schools ($4.9M+ state aid/yr)
├── EXTRACTION ─ Purpose Group LLC (72.67% of revenue)
├── POLITICAL ── PACs + CBC Week events
├── JUDICIAL ─── 4 Wayne County judges with documented network connections
└── ASSOCIATE ── Joseph Holland Jr (convicted drug offender, all financial roles)
```

### Potential Predicate Acts — Submitted for Agency Determination

*The following are investigative questions submitted to federal agencies. They are not adjudicated findings.*

| Potential Act | Statute | Documented Facts |
|---------------|---------|------------------|
| Mail/Wire Fraud | § 1341/1343 | Banks' dissertation lists "J.D., MSU Law, 2010" — no bar admission found in public records; credential appears on school websites |
| Financial Irregularity | § 1956 | $4.28M/yr flows through Purpose Group LLC management contract; $348K not separately itemized in available budget documents |
| Campaign Payments | § 201 | Sitting judge's campaign paid $383.82 to Banks Strategy LLC (sole contribution and sole expenditure) — whether this constitutes a legal violation is for agencies to determine |
| Recusal Questions | § 1503 | Judges with documented network connections presided over network-connected cases — whether recusal was required is a judicial conduct question |

### Documented Judicial Connections

*These are documented facts. Whether they constitute conflicts of interest is a matter for the Judicial Tenure Commission.*

Four Wayne County judges have documented connections to the Banks network:
- **Board membership**: Judge Miller serves as Board Chair of Anchor Rock Foundation (*public record*)
- **Campaign payment**: Judge Yancey's campaign paid $383.82 to Banks Strategy LLC — sole contribution and sole expenditure (*campaign finance filing*)
- **Same institution/cohort**: Judge Sabree attended MSU Law in the same period Banks claims to have attended (*shared enrollment year does not establish personal knowledge*)
- **Family donations**: Perkins family members donated to Banks-aligned campaigns (*donations do not establish judicial participation*)

Between September 21 and October 1, 2026, Kevin Mok submitted referral packets to **eight federal agencies**, the **Michigan Department of Education**, and the **Judicial Tenure Commission**. Every referral is documented below with dates, case numbers where assigned, and current status.

All federal referrals pre-date Banks's retaliatory police report (September 28) and PPO hearing appearance (September 29). The timeline is documented in the [9-LINE Federal Referral cover sheet](/docs/federal-referrals/9LINE_FEDERAL_REFERRAL_SEP25.pdf).

---

## The 9-LINE

The federal referral packet was delivered using a GTA 08-01-004 MEDEVAC format — the military standard for requesting medical evacuation. The format was adapted for a federal criminal referral because the complainant is a combat arms veteran and the 9-LINE format forces structured, unambiguous communication of:

- **Location** of the emergency
- **Number of patients** (victims) by triage priority
- **Special equipment** (agencies) required
- **Security** at pickup site (threat assessment)
- **Method of marking** (how to verify the evidence)

The 9-LINE is available here: [9LINE_FEDERAL_REFERRAL_SEP25.pdf](/docs/federal-referrals/9LINE_FEDERAL_REFERRAL_SEP25.pdf)

> *"The bleeding started 14 years ago. This is the 9-LINE. Get the bird in the air."*


This is not a timeline of threats. This is a timeline of a citizen using every lawful channel available — and the subject of the investigation retaliating for it.

## The Pattern

| Date | Communication | Response Time |
|------|---------------|---------------|
| Sep 30 | Crump-Gibson enters | Same day |
| Oct 1 | Crump-Gibson disclaimer | ~20 minutes after Kevin's prior email |
| Oct 2, 10:41 AM | Kevin: standing, boards, GAL | **Silence** |
| Oct 2, 10:41 AM | Kevin: 9-line federal referral | **Silence** |
| Oct 2, 12:10 PM | Kevin: academic paper | **Silence** |
| Oct 2, 3:02 PM | Kevin: working together | **Silence** |
| Oct 3+ | ... | **Silence continues** |

Prior to October 2, response times were approximately 20 minutes. After receiving documented evidence of Banks's criminal history, federal referrals, board overlap, and Plaintiff's scientific methodology, response times became infinite.

The silence speaks.

---

## What the Correspondence Proves

1. **GLLG has documented notice** of every factual allegation in the civil complaints, established by email with timestamps
2. **GLLG chose to limit scope** within 24 hours (the October 1 disclaimer)
3. **GLLG received and did not respond to** evidence of federal referrals, board overlap, and the RICO pattern
4. **The shift from rapid response to silence** correlates precisely with the volume and nature of evidence Kevin provided
5. **Every document Kevin referenced** is independently verifiable using free or low-cost public databases (ICHAT $10, State Bar free, PACER $0.10/page, LARA free)

Whether GLLG verified the allegations or not, the correspondence chain establishes that they had the information, the means to verify it, and the professional obligation to investigate.

## Filing Philosophy

Kevin Mok is not a lawyer. He is a scientist who filed lawsuits because no lawyer, prosecutor, or agency acted on the evidence.

The first complaint was rough. It was a hypothesis — a first draft. Like a dissertation, it was meant to be refined as data was collected. The first amended complaint was better. The second amended complaint was better still. Each filing incorporates new public-record evidence discovered through FOIA, ICHAT, PACER, LARA, and Wayne County ROD.

The filings will continue to improve because the research continues. The case is the data. The suit is the delivery mechanism.

> *"I am not interested in settlement. I am not interested in a lawyer who wants to make this smaller. I want jury trial, accountability, and resignations."*

On August 4, 2023, State Superintendent Michael F. Rice issued Brian Roderick Banks a Michigan School Administrator Certificate — despite Banks having **eight felony fraud convictions** at the time (a ninth had been reduced to a misdemeanor in 2017).

The certificate came with **seven restrictive conditions**. This page documents the hearing, the witnesses, the conditions, and what has happened since.

---

## The Hearing — February 9, 2023

The TCR 22-12 hearing was held before an Administrative Law Judge at the Michigan Office of Administrative Hearings and Rules (MOAHR).

### The Positions

| Party | Position |
|-------|----------|
| **MDE Department** | **Objected to reinstatement** — argued Banks's criminal record disqualified him |
| **Attorney General** | **Argued against the certificate** — supported the Department's objection |
| **Administrative Law Judge** | Recommended **no conditions** — effectively a rubber stamp |
| **State Superintendent Rice** | **Overruled the ALJ** — issued the certificate with 7 conditions |

The Superintendent overruled his own ALJ to add conditions the ALJ didn't think were necessary. The Department and AG both opposed the certificate entirely. The ALJ recommended giving it to Banks with no restrictions.
